gloss: Buddhist altar fittings; Buddhist ritual implements

definitions.gloss: Buddhist altar fittings; Buddhist ritual implements
definitions.explanation: Objects and utensils used in Buddhist worship, including items placed on a home altar or used in temple ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {仏具|ぶつぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: To polish the Buddhist altar fittings.

examples.english: I bought an incense holder at a Buddhist supplies shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仏具|ぶつぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。

notes:
A compound of {仏|ぶつ} (Buddha/Buddhist) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (implements/tools). Refers to the various objects used in Buddhist practice, both at home altars (⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧) and at temples.

Common {仏具|ぶつぐ} items include candlesticks (⟦{燭台|しょくだい}→燭台：22975_shokudai⟧), incense burners (⟦{香炉|こうろ}→香炉：06296_kouro⟧), flower vases ({花立|はなたて}), bells ({鈴|りん}), and offering dishes. Most Japanese households that maintain a ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧ have a basic set of these items.

- {仏具|ぶつぐ}{店|てん}: Buddhist supplies shop
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to assemble a set of altar fittings
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish the altar fittings
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧: a full set of altar fittings
